milestones.title: Phase 0 — Arrow Dataset Generation
milestones.objective: Master Arrow repository, partition pipeline in {pipdata}, release manifest generation.

features.title: Version as partition key with manifest-based resolution
features.description: Add version (vermast_veralt) as a 4th Hive partition key. Manifest file_path is the sole version-resolution mechanism for {piptm}. Multiple versions coexist on disk.

features.title: Manifest generation and partition-filter loading
features.description: Transition manifest from file_path to partition filter keys. Release-inventory-driven generation in {pipdata} with dimension introspection. Manifest loading and open_dataset()|>filter() data access in {piptm}.

milestones.title: Phase 1 — Computation Engine
milestones.objective: Core computation engine: family-based orchestrator for poverty, inequality, and welfare measures with disaggregation across dimensions.

features.title: Measure registry and input validation
features.description: Define canonical measures (5 poverty, 2 inequality, 12 welfare) in .MEASURE_REGISTRY. Implement .classify_measures(), .validate_by(), .validate_poverty_lines() validators.

features.title: Family-level compute functions
features.description: Implement compute_poverty() (FGT measures), compute_inequality() (Gini, MLD), compute_welfare() (mean, median, quantiles, etc.) with collapse backend.

features.title: Family-based computation orchestrator (compute_measures)
features.description: Orchestrator dispatches compute_poverty(), compute_inequality(), compute_welfare() based on requested measure families. Builds compound GRP(c('pip_id', by)) for batch processing. Long-format output with poverty_line, measure, value, population columns.

features.title: Disaggregation across dimensions (gender, area, education, age)
features.description: Support up to 4 dimensions including at most 1 education column. Age binning (0–14, 15–24, 25–64, 65+). Dimension pre-filter with warnings. Surveys missing any requested dimension are excluded before loading.

milestones.title: Phase 2 — table_maker() Top-Level API
milestones.objective: Build the top-level table_maker() API function, data loading pipeline, and orchestration layer. Implement pip_lookup() triplet resolver. Optimize orchestration and I/O.

features.title: table_maker() with dual input patterns (pip_id and triplets)
features.description: Implement table_maker(pip_id | country_code/year/welfare_type, measures, poverty_lines, by, release). Accept pip_id for API usage; fall back to triplet resolution via pip_lookup() for ad-hoc R console usage.

features.title: pip_lookup() triplet-to-pip_id resolver
features.description: Translate human-friendly (country_code, year, welfare_type) tuples to canonical pip_ids via manifest inner join. Emit warnings for unmatched triplets.

features.title: load_surveys() data loading with manifest resolution
features.description: Resolve manifest entries to Arrow partition paths. Lazy load via open_dataset(). Column selection and dictionary casting. Return with metadata columns (pip_id, country_code, surveyid_year, welfare_type).

features.title: Orchestration: batch vs. per-survey optimization
features.description: Compare Approach A (per-survey lapply with GRP rebuild) vs Approach B (single batch GRP). Benchmark on 15 surveys × 50 iterations. Adopt Approach B (72% faster, 0.127s vs 0.432s). Update table_maker() implementation.

features.title: Arrow push-down vs. in-memory compute benchmark
features.description: Measure feasibility of pushing grouping/aggregation to Arrow vs. loading and computing in R. Identify which measures can be pushed down. Document performance implications for future optimization.

features.title: Column-pruned Arrow reads (I/O optimization)
features.description: Add cols parameter to load_surveys(); select() before collect() to skip bytes on the network. 68% I/O reduction (1.658s → 0.524s, 15 surveys over UNC share). E2E pipeline 29% faster (2.370s → 1.675s).

features.title: Remove redundant welfare sort in compute_inequality()
features.description: compute_inequality() relies on upstream write-sorted Arrow data instead of sorting internally. is.unsorted() guard errors on unsorted input; multi-file guard prevents concatenation from breaking the sort contract.

milestones.title: Phase 3 — Validation, Testing & Quality
milestones.objective: Build comprehensive test suite, parquet validation layer, performance profiling, and documentation.

features.title: Parquet file validation (schema + data checks)
features.description: Implement validate_parquet_schema() (structural checks, dictionary type index width tolerance) and validate_parquet_data() (row-level validation: required columns present, no NAs in welfare/weight, factor level checks). Fast schema-only checks for pipeline validation. Core implementation complete; pending: extract duplicate .find_welfare_col() logic into single helper, add test for cols+ppp=NULL path.

features.title: Unit test suite (≥90% coverage)
features.description: Tests for measure registry, validators, family compute functions, orchestrator, data loading, and table_maker(). Fixture-based testing with synthetic survey data. 414+ tests passing.

features.title: Performance benchmarking and profiling
features.description: Profile I/O, compute, and GC overhead. Document 15-survey and 100-survey performance. Column-pruning I/O optimization applied (2026-05-21): 68% I/O reduction; E2E pipeline 29% faster.

features.title: Data quality contracts and multi-file guard
features.description: Enforce welfare sort invariant and one-file-per-partition contract. Gini pre-sort validation in compute_inequality() (is.unsorted guard). Multi-file concatenation guard in .build_parquet_paths(). Solution doc: .cg-docs/solutions/data-quality/2026-05-21-arrow-multifile-partition-sort-violation.md.

features.title: Dimension pre-filter: exclude partial-match surveys
features.description: Refactored table_maker() Step 3 so surveys missing any requested breakdown dimension are excluded before loading (manifest check only), not loaded and NA-filled. Warning message lists each excluded survey and which dimensions it lacked.

features.title: Exported functions test sync
features.description: Align exported functions with their test coverage after API/compute refactors (analysis_var routing, scalar poverty_line). Sync tests to the current exported surface.

features.title: Documentation: API reference and developer guide
features.description: roxygen2 docstrings for all exported and internal functions. Developer guide for extending measure registry. Architecture overview (manifest, computation pipeline, output schema).

features.title: CRAN readiness (devtools::check clean)
features.description: Resolve all warnings, notes, and errors from R CMD check. Finalize NAMESPACE, imports, and package metadata.

milestones.title: Phase 4 — API Service Layer
milestones.objective: Plumber service layer connecting the PIP UI platform to table_maker(): core table/lookup endpoints, static catalogues, session surveys, request validation, and response serialization.

features.title: Plumber /table endpoint (GET/POST)
features.description: Accept pip_id vector, measures, poverty_lines, by dimensions. Return long-format JSON with poverty_line, measure, value, population. Support batch requests (>50 surveys via POST with JSON body).

features.title: Plumber /lookup endpoint
features.description: Resolve (country_code, year, welfare_type) triplets to pip_ids for UI discovery. Caching layer for manifest queries.

features.title: Static catalogue endpoints (categories, measures, covariates, stats)
features.description: pip_tablemaker_categories(), measures, covariates and summary-stats catalogue endpoints. Measure spec YAML drives the build registry and stats endpoint. GET categories structure fixes.

features.title: Variable registry and measure spec YAML
features.description: UI variable spec YAML and tm measure spec YAML. Schema and registry refactor to include measure spec; refactor to use pip_optional_dims.

features.title: Countries and regions endpoints
features.description: Countries and regions listing endpoints. Load filtered sample base in table_maker().

features.title: analysis_var routing and scalar poverty_line
features.description: feat(api,compute): add analysis_var routing and scalar poverty_line across the table pipeline. Table endpoint computation refactor (2026-07-01).

features.title: Session surveys endpoints
features.description: Session surveys endpoints for survey selection persistence. pip_ids param for categories and covariates endpoints. Insomnia test collections for endpoint verification.

features.title: API deployment documentation
features.description: API deployment README covering environment variables, data connections, and running the Plumber service.

features.title: Survey-specific variable filtering for Step 2
features.description: Filter which variables (dimensions, welfare types, PPPs) apply per survey so the UI only offers valid options for the selected surveys.

features.title: Error handling, logging, and request tracing
features.description: Structured error responses (invalid pip_ids, unsupported measures, missing poverty_lines). Request logging with timestamps and parameter echoing. Optional telemetry for performance monitoring.

features.title: Step 3 description file for table results
features.description: Generate structured markdown document describing table configuration: surveys analyzed, sample base filters, statistics computed, disaggregation structure, poverty line, PPP year, suppression threshold, and warnings. New build_table_description() function in R package and /description API endpoint. UI displays inline or downloads as PDF.

features.title: Session storage endpoints for survey selection persistence
features.description: Persist survey selections and table configuration across UI sessions via server-side session storage endpoints.

milestones.title: Phase 5 — PPP Parameter Handling & Refactor
milestones.objective: End-to-end resolution of all PPP parameter handling: data loading (manifest-driven welfare column selection, skip logic), API input validation (type guards, digit-only check, truncated error echo), and full test coverage of edge cases.

features.title: PPP welfare column resolution in load_surveys() / load_survey_microdata()
features.description: Manifest welfare_vars drives PPP resolution via .find_welfare_col(). load_survey_microdata() errors on missing PPP with available-PPPs hint. load_surveys() warns and skips surveys without the requested PPP column; errors only when all surveys are skipped. Column pruning translates logical 'welfare' to the physical PPP column name before open_dataset().

features.title: API PPP parameter validation refactor
features.description: Input type guard: only character or numeric accepted; lists, logicals, raw types rejected. Digit-only guard for string inputs. Truncated echo in error messages. Implemented in the plumber /table and /lookup endpoints.

features.title: PPP edge-case test coverage
features.description: 8 critical validation tests covering: hex notation (0x7D1), scientific notation (2e3), integer overflow, empty vector, multi-param accumulation, NULL, non-numeric string, and fractional year. All passing.

milestones.title: Phase 6 — Cell Share Measures
milestones.objective: Add obs_share (cell observation proportion) and pop_share (cell population proportion) to the welfare computation family. Per-survey denominators, integrated with the measure registry pattern.

features.title: obs_share and pop_share measures
features.description: Register obs_share and pop_share in .MEASURE_REGISTRY under welfare family. Compute as cell/survey ratios using coarser pip_id-only GRP for denominators. Reuse existing nobs when available. 21 total measures.

milestones.title: Phase 7 — Population Share Threshold-Based Suppression
milestones.objective: Implement configurable population share suppression rule that removes non-share measures from cells where pop_share falls below a threshold. Integrated into table_maker() API and plumber /table endpoint.

features.title: pop_share_threshold parameter and cell suppression logic
features.description: Add pop_share_threshold parameter to table_maker() (default 0.01). Validate threshold is NULL or numeric in (0, 1). In Step 10, extract pop_share rows, identify below-threshold cells, tag matching non-share rows with .suppress=TRUE, filter and emit warning. Anti-join pattern for efficient row matching. Subsequent fixes (2026-07-02): remove ghost obs_share from suppression output, shares denominator fix.

features.title: API validation and plumber endpoint integration
features.description: Update validate_table_input() to validate pop_share_threshold parameter. Update /table endpoint to accept and pass threshold to table_maker(). Plumber annotation documents the new parameter.

milestones.title: Phase 8 — PIP Platform UI Integration
milestones.objective: Stage 1 surveys UI in the PIP platform: survey selection and table configuration UI connected to the API service.

features.title: Stage 1 surveys UI
features.description: Survey selection interface in the PIP platform backed by the session surveys / countries / regions endpoints.

features.title: Pop-share threshold as always-active suppression guard
features.description: Treat pop-share threshold suppression as an always-on guard rather than an opt-in parameter, aligned with PIP disclosure rules.
